repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Final green head for L1 and same-head contract review (2026-11-25T11:10Z): `3696758dfc2947728c4f9537982488e12a19cdcd`.

- **Checks at this head:** 45 `success`, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Size:** 8 files; no governed path; `Fixes #36870`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, as measured; the seat accepted it and the claim amendment is 7160292090. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **What it does:**
  - `queryGroupHeaders` (`data-objectstack`) sets `hasMore = true` on the rows array it returns when `POST /data/:object/query` answers `hasMore: true`.
  - `@object-ui/types` exports `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer` (the rows plus an optional `hasMore`) as the member's return. Every caller that reads the answer as an array is unchanged.
  - The kanban lane read goes through `readLaneStatistic`, which returns `null` on a partial answer, so no lane draws a figure. That closes both residual cases in 7124305685.
- **Evidence:**
  - New pins: `queryGroupHeaders-7189.test.ts`, and a describe in `ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx`; each has a control.
  - Ablations: removing the partial check gives 2 red with the control green; removing the adapter's flag gives 1 red. Both were restored to HEAD.
  - Tests: 3 package suites (12516 tests) and 40 consumer files (569 tests) green; type-check green.
  - Gates: 40 of 40 derived.
- **Points for L1 and the contract review:**
  - The widening is one new exported type name (0 hits at base) and one optional field on the member's return. A `tsc --strict` probe shows a plain array still satisfies the member.
  - Declared narrowing: type-check ran outside the verify lock after lock timeouts.
  - The grouped grid and the used-currency read don't read `hasMore` yet; that is carried by #37278.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `3696758dfc2947728c4f9537982488e12a19cdcd`
Local-runs: probe — one throwaway worktree at this head (deps symlinked, removed after): the two pin files, three ablations and one `tsc --strict` implementer probe, as the seat's brief asked

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and on `.changeset/36870-group-headers-has-more.md`; no published spec and no governed path in the 8 files). `record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths …` refused to decide from paths alone and named the changeset's `Clause-②:` line; that line has no `(narrowing)` arm, so the owed tier is `--face declaration` = `TIER_DEFAULT`. No `## ④`, no `Scope:` line on this face.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The exported type is additive.** `ui/packages/types/src/index.ts` adds one name to an existing `export type { … }` list; `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer` has 0 hits under `ui/` at base `9171bed0a`. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **The member's return widens for callers and does not narrow for implementers.** `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders?` now answers `Promise<ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer>` = `ListViewGroupHeaderRow[] & { hasMore?: boolean }`. My own probe, compiled with `ui/packages/types/tsconfig.json` (strict) at this head:
  - a class `implements DataSource` whose `queryGroupHeaders()` returns `Promise<ListViewGroupHeaderRow[]>` compiles;
  - an object literal typed `DataSource` that returns a plain row array compiles;
  - a caller assigning the answer to `ListViewGroupHeaderRow[]` and mapping it compiles;
  - `// @ts-expect-error` on `hasMore: 'yes'` held, so the field is typed;
  - an injected control error was reported, so the probe file was in the program.
  Weak-type detection does not fire on an intersection target's optional-only constituent, which is why a plain array is assignable. A plain `T[]` stays assignable, so no implementer must change, and this is not a narrowing for implementers.
- **In-repo implementers and wrappers.** There is one real implementer, `ObjectStackAdapter` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`), and it is updated. `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` refuses the member. Five Proxy wrappers forward the member by `bind`, so they return the same array object and the flag survives: `unpublishedObjectReads.ts`, `previewFormDataSource.ts`, `canvasDataSource.ts`, `DataPillarHelpers.tsx`, and the routed source in `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`. Test doubles returning plain arrays stay assignable, and CI's type-check lanes are green.
- **The flag is carried truthfully, and this is a root-cause fix, not a mask.**
  - Server: `protocol-data-crud.ts`'s grouped branch computes `hasMore: limited.length < records.length` from the full aggregate before slicing. Under `OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE` alone, the default page size falls back to the max (`query-read-limits.ts:233`). A row-budget-only deployment refuses instead of cutting (`assertQueryReadRows`), and the kanban reads that refusal as no figure.
  - Client: `@objectstack/client` `data.query` returns the unwrapped `PaginatedResult` with `hasMore`.
  - Adapter: it sets `answer.hasMore = true` only on `=== true`, so a whole answer carries no key.
  - Lane read: `compileLaneStatisticQuery` sends no `limit`, so the only cut is the door's default page.
  - Kanban: it routes through `readLaneStatistic`, which returns `null` when `Array.isArray(answer) && answer.hasMore === true`.
- **Pins and ablations, re-run here.**
  - Both pin files: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 28 passed (28)`.
  - Ablation A: deleting the partial-check line in `readLaneStatistic` makes both 36870 kanban pins red, and CONTROL stays green (`2 failed | 1 passed | 19 skipped`).
  - Ablation B: deleting the adapter's `answer.hasMore = true` makes `sets hasMore on an answer capped by a small default page size` red (`1 failed | 5 passed`).
  - Ablation C (mine): reverting the `ObjectKanban.tsx` call site to `readLaneFigures` makes both kanban pins red (`2 failed | 1 passed`).
  - Each mutation was restored, and `git status` was clean after each.
- **The control case is covered.** With page size 4 (the whole answer), every lane draws its figure: Open 2415, Won 10, Lost 0, Uncategorized 4, and `hasMore` is undefined. The adapter's CONTROL (page size 100) shows `hasMore` undefined and all 5 rows.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is correct as measured, and the claim amendment 2026-11-25T10:52:40Z (7160292090) adopts it over the claim's `no`. The dev's one open question (option A, keep the widening) is answered by that amendment, and I concur.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct. Nothing a metadata author writes changes: `kanban.summary` keeps its keys, values and meaning, and only the drawing over a partial server answer changes.
- The level is `patch` on `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`. All three are public at 18.6.0, and AGENTS.md says a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. No BREAKING banner, and no ADR-0087 marker is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags.**
  - The two type-check runs ran outside the verify lock. This is a declared process narrowing, `tsc --noEmit` writes nothing, and CI's type-check lanes are green at this head. Answered.
  - The out-of-scope finding (`useServerGrouping`, `usedCurrencyCodes`) is now carried by #37278 (`Blocked-by: #36870`). `useWholeSetSummary` sends no `groupBy` and reads exactly one row, so the default page cannot cut it. Answered.
- **SQL push-down.** There is no new id materialisation and no in-app join. The lane figures stay one server-side grouped aggregate, and the in-memory group slice is the door's pre-existing behaviour, not this diff's.
- **CI.** At this head: 58 check-runs, 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed or pending.
- **Merge state.**
  - K = 8: merge-base `9171bed0a` against `origin/main` `f9fda2a4f`.
  - Local `git merge-tree --write-tree` is clean, and none of the 8 paths routes to `merge=os-regen`.
  - GitHub reports `mergeable_state: clean`.
  - Main's 8 commits since the merge-base touch none of the PR's files.
- **Overlap.** None of the three shares a path with this PR, and none of their diffs mentions `queryGroupHeaders`:
  - #36412 (`claude/issue-36412-currency-change-notes`): fields widgets, plugin-form and i18n.
  - #36855 (`claude/issue-36855-bulk-approve-reasons`): console system pages and i18n.
  - #37264 (fields, head `c69148c98`): `ui/packages/fields` only.
- PR-body wording findings, on the 维护者速读 and on the acceptance-note carrier, are L1 business and are written in the L1, not here.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36870-group-headers-hasmore`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `3696758dfc2947728c4f9537982488e12a19cdcd` · 2026-11-25T11:18Z

- **Card.** PR #37277 implements card #36870 (zone a4-C) on branch `claude/issue-36870-group-headers-hasmore`. It is a draft with 8 files. The same-head contract review at `TIER_DEFAULT` (declaration face) is a PASS.
- **Root cause, not a mask.**
  - The server's grouped branch derives `hasMore` from the full aggregate before slicing (`protocol-data-crud.ts`, `limited.length < records.length`).
  - The client returns it unwrapped.
  - The adapter now puts it on the returned array, and only when it is `=== true`.
  - The lane read sends no `limit`, so the default page is the only cut.
  - A max-page-size-only deployment falls back to max as the default page, and a row-budget-only deployment refuses (a 400), which the kanban already reads as no figure. No truncating path reaches the board unflagged.
- **The widening is honest.**
  - `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer` is one new export, with 0 hits at base.
  - My strict `tsc` probe at this head shows that a class implementer and an object-literal implementer returning a plain `ListViewGroupHeaderRow[]` both still satisfy `DataSource`, and that an array-typed caller compiles. The probe was verified live by an injected control error. So implementers are not narrowed.
  - In-repo, the only implementer is `ObjectStackAdapter`, which is updated. One routed source refuses the member, and five Proxy wrappers forward it by `bind` with the same array, so the flag survives them.
- **"No number on any lane when incomplete" is pinned, and I re-ran it.**
  - Pins: 2 files, 28 passed.
  - Ablation A (`readLaneStatistic` partial check deleted) turns both kanban pins red while CONTROL stays green.
  - Ablation B (adapter `answer.hasMore = true` deleted) turns the adapter pin red.
  - Ablation C (mine: the `ObjectKanban` call site reverted to `readLaneFigures`) turns both kanban pins red.
  - CONTROL, a whole answer: Open 2415, Won 10, Lost 0, Uncategorized 4.
  - All mutations were restored.
- **Declarations.**
  - `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is correct and matches claim amendment 7160292090 (2026-11-25T10:52:40Z). The dev's open question resolves to A.
  - `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct.
  - The changeset is `patch` on three public `@object-ui/*` packages, as AGENTS.md says for a non-protocol widening.
- **CI, K and merge.**
  - CI: 58 check-runs, 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed or pending.
  - K = 8 against `origin/main` `f9fda2a4f`.
  - `merge-tree` is clean, no path routes to `os-regen`, and GitHub reports `clean`.
- **Overlap.** There is none.
  - #36412's branch touches fields widgets, plugin-form and i18n.
  - #36855's branch touches console system pages and i18n.
  - #37264 touches `ui/packages/fields` only.
  - No shared path, and none of them mentions `queryGroupHeaders`.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** Every sentence is accurate:
  - the Clause-② line;
  - the page-size env pair, since max alone becomes the default;
  - the adapter before and after;
  - `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` as the only types read from the server, since `count` is not;
  - the two residues;
  - the control;
  - the grid and currency reads unchanged.
- **维护者速读, sentence by sentence.**
  - 「用户能看到什么变化」 is accurate.
  - 「为什么做」 overclaims (S1).
  - 「出错会怎样」 is accurate: a partial answer can only hide a figure, and the grid and currency reads are untouched.
  - 「要你做什么:无」 is accurate.
- S1 (should-fix) — 维护者速读 「为什么做」 calls this PR 「看板泳道统计这一族工作的收尾」 (the close of the kanban lane statistic family). The family is not closed:
  - #36871 (the kanban lane 合计 on a one-page board, which the claim names as "the same family, follows serially") is still `pm:queue`;
  - #37278 is filed as "the #36870 family", `Blocked-by: #36870`.
  The fix is to drop 「这一族工作的收尾」 and say it closes the two residues of scope note 7124305685. This is a body-only edit with no head move.
- S2 (should-fix) — The PR body's Acceptance notes still say the `useServerGrouping` / `usedCurrencyCodes` gap is "nothing is filed (carrier: none)". #37278 now carries it (2026-11-25T10:56:52Z). The fix is to name #37278 as the carrier, so the PR does not read as burying the gap. This is a body-only edit with no head move.
- N1 — `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx:219` still describes `queryGroupHeaders` as "one row per group with its true `count`" and does not mention that an answer can be partial (`hasMore`). The jsdoc carries the new contract and the hand-written page does not. This can ride with #37278 or a docs touch-up.
- N2 — The adapter and kanban halves are pinned separately and joined only by shape: the kanban double sets `hasMore` itself. The flag is an expando on an array, so a future wrapper that copies the answer (`[...rows]`, `.slice()`, a structured clone) drops it silently and the board reads a cut answer as whole. Nothing in-repo does that today. A one-line warning on `ListViewGroupHeaderAnswer`'s jsdoc would keep it so.
- **Path to ACCEPT.** Fix S1 and S2 in the PR body. With no head move, this L1 and the PASS contract record (`TIER_DEFAULT`, head `3696758dfc2947728c4f9537982488e12a19cdcd`) stand, and the re-read is the body diff only.
